mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we have clear conditions near the Verona Area High School under a third quarter moon. We are looking at an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month, honoring the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our city's future and development. Additionally, a reminder that road work on Highway M near the future Aldi site starts October 6 through October 9, so plan your commutes accordingly.

There is a busy weekend ahead! Today you can enjoy the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center, live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Farley Center Fall Festival. Tomorrow, look for yoga at Insight Wellness, and starting October 6, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local activity, a retail theft was reported on September 21 at a business on East Verona Avenue where a suspect was identified stealing candy and subsequently cited by officers.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Andes Mint Avalanche. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
